scope: Full daily Power Stack research refresh across all tracked categories, every existing idea, US/Hong Kong-China/Malaysia, and every canonical current holding. Research/data only; no site code, UI, scoring, automation or backend changes.
decision: No existing core idea received a formal conviction promotion/demotion. NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 materially strengthens the physical-AI demand read-through and justifies research-priority upgrades for AMKR (8.1 to 8.3) and ASMPT/0522.HK (8.4 to 8.5), without changing base portfolio conviction. Aggreko (proposed NYSE: AGKO) remains the only genuinely new differentiated high-priority watch pending IPO valuation.

watch.name: Aggreko
watch.reason: Temporary/behind-the-meter power directly monetises the data-centre time-to-power bottleneck. H1 revenue +28% to about $1.92bn, profitability turned positive, data-centre revenue nearly doubled and secured net revenue exceeds $6bn.
watch.nextTest: IPO price range, enterprise value, leverage, sponsor sell-down, fleet capex and customer concentration.

notPromoted.reason: Maverick Power strengthens data-centre power distribution but acquisition valuation/integration need monitoring.
Attractive grid exposure but insufficient differentiation versus the existing stack.

macro.read: Physical AI demand strengthened materially after NVIDIA Q2, while long yields remain restrictive and financing/ROI discipline still matters. The 10Y Treasury was around 4.67% in Aug 27 trading. Refined-product scarcity remains more acute than crude scarcity; diesel cracks have exceeded $100/bbl during the August shock. Malaysia power/data-centre demand remains structurally strong. China remains a selective industrial/technology rather than broad-reflation trade.
developingThemes: AI demand acceleration versus financing quality
very strong El Nino second-order risks

categoryReads.Power / Grid: Highest-quality core category. NVIDIA's $96.2bn Q2 revenue and $89.0bn Data Center revenue (+117% y/y) strengthen confidence in future load growth. Southern Cable's RM1.36bn order book remains a strong Malaysia confirmation; Aggreko adds differentiated time-to-power optionality.
categoryReads.AI / Data centres: Materially stronger demand evidence today. NVIDIA Q2 revenue +106% y/y, Data Center +117% and Q3 revenue guide of $108bn reduce the near-term demand-duration concern. AMKR research priority rises 8.1→8.3 because NVIDIA's $1.5bn prepayment helps fund scarce US packaging capacity; ASMPT rises 8.4→8.5 on stronger HBM/advanced-packaging demand read-through. Financing/ROI and valuation remain counterweights.
categoryReads.Nuclear: No hierarchy change: operating generation/components/fuel remain preferred to pre-commercial reactor duration.
categoryReads.Uranium / Fuel: Structural contracting/enrichment thesis intact; no fresh evidence clears a conviction-change bar.
categoryReads.Oil & Gas: Refined products remain the differentiated shortage. Integrated majors, refiners and product logistics retain better current transmission than indiscriminate upstream beta.
categoryReads.Metals: Copper remains preferred structural metal because grid/data-centre electrical demand is visible; China cyclicality and high rates cap enthusiasm for generic miners.
categoryReads.Robotics / Automation: Sequence unchanged: warehouse/fixed automation, cobots/mobile manipulation, industrial humanoids, open-world robots. Strong NVIDIA compute demand does not prove humanoid economics; Symbotic's profitable Q3 remains better commercial evidence.
categoryReads.Malaysia: Southern Cable remains today's strongest physical-stack confirmation. TNB/YTL Power retain structural data-centre/grid exposure; no new Malaysian ticker beats existing differentiated names.
categoryReads.Hong Kong / China: ASMPT research priority rises to 8.5 on stronger HBM/packaging read-through. CGN Power/Dongfang remain strategic infrastructure exposures; no broad China recovery upgrade.
